title: CppCon 2014: Zaika Antoun "Microsoft w/ C++ to Deliver Office Across Different Platforms, Part I"
summary: A CppCon 2014 talk from Microsoft engineers on using portable single-source C++ to deliver Office across iOS, Android, Windows and Mac. It covers architectures, techniques and lessons from real cross-platform projects.
why: Cited as evidence that large production apps share a C++ core with native UI, in cross-platform and React Native or Flutter debates.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: There's a pretty interesting video of how the Office team uses C++ for their cross-platform efforts
